input.text: Direct response (partial, in progress): I have read the R sources (R/frsr.R, bin.R, phase.R, sample.R, threads.R, RcppExports.R), the C++ sources read so far (src/RcppExports.cpp, frsr.cpp, frsr.h, Makevars), NAMESPACE, DESCRIPTION, NEWS.md and LICENSE. Still to read: src/phase.cpp, sample.cpp, search.cpp and their headers, the four man/*.Rd files, and the tests. All four functions are exported in NAMESPACE. Known discrepancies so far: frsr.Rd usage shows magic = 1597463007 while the text says 0x5f3759df (same value); frsr_bin NEWS says settings records 'bounds' but the code records only magic_min/magic_max; frsr_phase has no threads argument and does not call frsrr_configure_threads; frsr_sample has no threads argument but forwards ... to frsr(); frsr_sample's docs say keep_params defaults to FALSE but it is passed only through ... .
